actions: adduct toes 3-5 toward the axial line (digit 2)

functional_compartments.function_note: 3 separate small unipennate muscles (TA: interossei plantares I-III) -- the foot's structural analog of the hand's palmar interossei, again referenced to digit 2 rather than digit 3.
